text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on College Street, City Council approval of this report is required. SKYGRiD Construction Incorporated is constructing mixed-use commercial retail and residential suites at the lands municipally known as 547, 549 and 555 College Street. This development includes 3-story building and a 6-story commercial building. The site is bounded by a public laneway to the south, existing commercial building to the east and College Street to the north, and Manning Avenue to the west. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the sidewalk on the south side of College Street and remove 6 pay parking spots on College Street within the lay-by. This occupation is Phase 2 for development of this site and would be required for the duration of 20 months to accommodate shoring and excavation work construction staging operations…

City Council approve the closure of the sidewalk approximately 30.0 metres east of Manning Avenue and a point approximately 30.0 metres further east, from March 1, 2019 to October 31, 2020. 2. City Council approve the closure of the lay-by lane on the south side of College Street from Manning Avenue to a point approximately 36.0 metres east from March 1, 2019 to October 31, 2020. 3. City Council rescind the existing parking machine regulation in effect on the south side of College Street from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., Sundays from a point 17.0 metres east of Manning Avenue to a point approximately 91.0 metres east. 4.
